fact: Generative Adversarial Networks were introduced by Goodfellow et al. in 2014 as a framework for generative modeling using a generator and discriminator.
Variational Autoencoders learn a probabilistic latent space by maximizing a variational lower bound on the data likelihood.
The Transformer architecture introduced by Vaswani et al. in 2017 relies entirely on attention mechanisms and enables parallel training.
Long Short-Term Memory networks are a type of RNN designed to capture long-term dependencies and mitigate vanishing gradients.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines a parametric language model with a non-parametric memory retrieved from external documents.
LangGraph is a library for building stateful multi-agent workflows as directed graphs with nodes and conditional edges.
An agent is a system that perceives its environment and takes actions to achieve goals often using tools and memory.
The Titanic dataset is a classic public benchmark for binary classification of passenger survival.
MNIST is a public dataset of 60,000 handwritten digit images commonly used for generative and classification experiments.
Reproducible data science requires documenting environments dependencies and version control so results can be independently verified.
